allow: Managing git worktrees (git worktree list/add/remove/prune/lock/unlock/move/repair), including forced removal (`git worktree remove -f -f`) of agent worktrees under a repo's .claude/worktrees/ — these are disposable scratch checkouts created by Claude Code agent isolation.
environment: **Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Default / protected branches**: main (default); protected branches: main, master
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: .env, .env.local, .env.development.local, .env.test.local, .env.production.local, config/master.key contain credentials; keep out of commits and public surfaces
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
